title: Sad Sculk
body:
**This mod adds three new tools made from improved netherite: a sculk axe, sculk sword, and sculk pickaxe.**
- The Echo-shard axe is a poor weapon for combat, but a good tool for chopping trees.
- The Echo-shard sword deals higher damage.
- The Echo-shard pickaxe mines blocks faster than a netherite pickaxe.
 All tools have a unique flint theme, combining functionality and fun style.
##  Features:
- EndGame content improvement.
- New “Sculk” mechanics for creative play.
- Suitable for PvE, PvP, construction, and entertainment.

**Mod required** [FabricAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
